metadata.description: Plugins that connect your agent to Stencils, the design tool whose canvas is real HTML and CSS.

plugins.name: stencils
plugins.description: Work in Stencils through the Mac app. Needs Stencils for Mac, opened and signed in once.

plugins.name: stencils-remote
plugins.description: Work in Stencils through Stencils' servers, from any computer. Signs in with your Stencils account in the browser.
